examples.en: If you can't find the book here, try looking elsewhere.
examples.zh: 如果你在這裡找不到那本書，可以去別的地方找找。

examples.en: The store is full, so we should go elsewhere for lunch.
examples.zh: 這家店客滿了，所以我們應該去別的地方吃午餐。

examples.en: Prices are lower elsewhere in the city.
examples.zh: 城裡其他地方的價格比較低。

examples.en: The embassy is open from nine to five on weekdays.
examples.zh: 大使館平日從九點開放到五點。

examples.en: She went to the embassy to renew her passport.
examples.zh: 她去大使館換發護照。

examples.en: The embassy sent a message to all citizens living abroad.
examples.zh: 大使館傳了一則訊息給所有住在國外的國民。

examples.en: A small rabbit emerged from behind the bush.
examples.zh: 一隻小兔子從灌木叢後面跑了出來。

examples.en: The sun finally emerged after three days of rain.
examples.zh: 連下三天雨之後，太陽終於露臉了。

examples.en: New problems often emerge when a project becomes larger.
examples.zh: 專案規模變大時，常常會出現新的問題。

examples.en: Our school puts great emphasis on reading.
examples.zh: 我們學校非常重視閱讀。

examples.en: The teacher placed special emphasis on the last chapter.
examples.zh: 老師特別強調最後一章。

examples.en: In this word, the emphasis falls on the first syllable.
examples.zh: 這個字的重音落在第一個音節。

examples.en: The Roman Empire once controlled much of Europe.
examples.zh: 羅馬帝國曾經控制歐洲的大部分地區。

examples.en: The emperor ruled a large empire for forty years.
examples.zh: 那位皇帝統治一個大帝國長達四十年。

examples.en: He built a food empire from one small restaurant.
examples.zh: 他從一間小餐廳起家，建立了餐飲王國。

examples.en: Please enclose a copy of your résumé with the email.
examples.zh: 請在信中附上一份你的履歷。

examples.en: A tall fence encloses the school playground.
examples.zh: 一道高高的圍籬圍住學校的操場。

examples.en: She enclosed a photo in the letter to her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她在寫給奶奶的信裡附了一張照片。

examples.en: We encountered heavy traffic on the way to the airport.
examples.zh: 我們前往機場的路上遇到嚴重塞車。

examples.en: Travelers may encounter language problems in a foreign country.
examples.zh: 旅客在國外可能會遇到語言上的問題。

examples.en: She encountered an old friend at the night market.
examples.zh: 她在夜市巧遇一位老朋友。

examples.en: My first encounter with snow was in Japan.
examples.zh: 我第一次見到雪是在日本。

examples.en: The two teams had an encounter in the final match.
examples.zh: 這兩支隊伍在決賽中碰頭。

examples.en: It was a brief encounter, but I remember it well.
examples.zh: 那只是一次短暫的相遇，但我記得很清楚。

examples.en: Littering can endanger the animals living in the river.
examples.zh: 亂丟垃圾可能危害住在河裡的動物。

examples.en: Driving too fast will endanger you and other drivers.
examples.zh: 開太快會讓你和其他駕駛人陷入危險。

examples.en: Pollution endangers the health of people in big cities.
examples.zh: 污染危害大城市居民的健康。

examples.en: The runners endured the hot weather during the race.
examples.zh: 跑者們在比賽中忍受著炎熱的天氣。

examples.en: I can't endure this noise any longer.
examples.zh: 我再也無法忍受這個噪音了。

examples.en: Their friendship has endured for more than twenty years.
examples.zh: 他們的友誼已經持續超過二十年。

examples.en: The police enforce the traffic laws in this area.
examples.zh: 警方在這一帶執行交通法規。

examples.en: Our school enforces a strict rule about wearing uniforms.
examples.zh: 我們學校嚴格執行穿制服的規定。

examples.en: It is hard to enforce a rule that nobody understands.
examples.zh: 沒有人了解的規定很難強制執行。

examples.en: She studied engineering at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一所大學念工程。

examples.en: Bridge engineering requires careful math and planning.
examples.zh: 橋梁工程需要仔細的計算與規劃。

examples.en: The company hired a new engineering team last month.
examples.zh: 這家公司上個月聘請了一個新的工程團隊。

examples.en: Can you enlarge this photo so we can print it?
examples.zh: 你可以把這張照片放大，讓我們列印嗎？

examples.en: The city plans to enlarge the old train station.
examples.zh: 市政府打算擴建那座老火車站。

examples.en: Click here to enlarge the map on your screen.
examples.zh: 點選這裡可以放大螢幕上的地圖。

examples.en: An enormous tree stands in front of our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校前面有一棵巨大的樹。

examples.en: The concert attracted an enormous crowd of young people.
examples.zh: 這場演唱會吸引了大批年輕人。

examples.en: Moving to a new city was an enormous change for her.
examples.zh: 搬到新城市對她來說是很大的改變。

examples.en: Please ensure that all the windows are closed before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請確認所有窗戶都已關好。

examples.en: The teacher checked the list to ensure nobody was missing.
examples.zh: 老師核對名單，確保沒有人漏掉。

examples.en: Regular exercise helps ensure good health.
examples.zh: 規律運動有助於維持健康。

examples.en: The clown entertained the children with funny tricks.
examples.zh: 小丑用有趣的把戲逗孩子們開心。

examples.en: We entertained our relatives at home during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間我們在家招待親戚。

examples.en: This game is designed to entertain young kids.
examples.zh: 這款遊戲是為了讓小朋友玩得開心而設計的。

examples.en: The students showed great enthusiasm for the science project.
examples.zh: 學生們對這個科學專案展現出極大的熱忱。

examples.en: She spoke about her trip with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 她熱情洋溢地談著她的旅行。

examples.en: His enthusiasm for music made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 他對音樂的熱情讓大家都笑了。

examples.en: Everyone should have equality in education.
examples.zh: 每個人在教育上都應該享有平等。

examples.en: The speech was about equality between men and women.
examples.zh: 這場演說的主題是男女平等。

examples.en: Our class discussed the importance of equality at work.
examples.zh: 我們班討論了工作場合中平等的重要性。

examples.en: The new classroom is equipped with a large screen.
examples.zh: 新教室配備了一個大螢幕。

examples.en: Parents should equip their children with basic safety knowledge.
examples.zh: 父母應該讓孩子具備基本的安全知識。

examples.en: We need to equip the kitchen before the restaurant opens.
examples.zh: 餐廳開幕前，我們得把廚房設備備齊。

examples.en: We live in the era of smartphones.
examples.zh: 我們活在智慧型手機的時代。

examples.en: My grandfather often talks about the era of black-and-white TV.
examples.zh: 我爺爺常常提起黑白電視的年代。

examples.en: The invention of the Internet began a new era.
examples.zh: 網際網路的發明開啟了一個新時代。

senses.zh: 必要的；不可或缺的；基本的

examples.en: Water is essential for all living things.
examples.zh: 水對所有生物都不可或缺。

examples.en: A passport is essential when you travel abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅行時護照是必備的。

examples.en: Good communication is essential in any team.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通在任何團隊中都是必要的。

examples.en: Pack the essentials, such as clothes and a toothbrush.
examples.zh: 把衣服和牙刷之類的必需品帶好。

examples.en: The guide covers the essentials of English grammar.
examples.zh: 這本指南涵蓋英文文法的基本要點。

examples.en: Food and water are the essentials for a hiking trip.
examples.zh: 食物和水是健行旅程中的必需品。

examples.en: The company was established in 1990.
examples.zh: 這家公司創立於一九九○年。

examples.en: They want to establish a new rule for the club.
examples.zh: 他們想為社團訂定一條新規則。

examples.en: It takes time to establish trust between friends.
examples.zh: 朋友之間建立信任需要時間。

examples.en: Experts estimate that the trip will take three hours.
examples.zh: 專家估計這趟旅程要三小時。

examples.en: Can you estimate how much the repairs will cost?
examples.zh: 你能估算修理要花多少錢嗎？

examples.en: We estimated the height of the tree to be ten meters.
examples.zh: 我們估計這棵樹高約十公尺。

examples.en: The mechanic gave us an estimate for the repair.
examples.zh: 技師給了我們一份維修報價。

examples.en: My estimate is that about fifty people will come.
examples.zh: 我的估計是大約會有五十人來。

examples.en: According to one estimate, the town has ten thousand people.
examples.zh: 根據一項估計，這個小鎮約有一萬人。

examples.en: The teacher will evaluate each student's final project.
examples.zh: 老師會評量每位學生的期末專案。

examples.en: We need to evaluate the cost before buying a car.
examples.zh: 買車之前我們得先評估費用。

examples.en: The company evaluates its workers once a year.
examples.zh: 公司每年評核員工一次。

examples.en: The team's eventual win surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍最後獲勝，讓所有人都很驚訝。

examples.en: Her eventual goal is to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她的最終目標是成為醫生。

examples.en: The eventual cost of the project was much higher than planned.
examples.zh: 這項專案最終的成本比原先計畫的高出許多。

examples.en: There is no evidence that the story is true.
examples.zh: 沒有證據顯示這個故事是真的。

examples.en: The scientist collected evidence from many places.
examples.zh: 科學家從許多地方蒐集證據。

examples.en: The wet floor was evidence that someone had just cleaned it.
examples.zh: 濕濕的地板顯示剛有人打掃過。

examples.en: It was evident that she had worked hard on the report.
examples.zh: 很明顯她在這份報告上下了很多功夫。

examples.en: His joy was evident from the big smile on his face.
examples.zh: 從他臉上的大大笑容可以明顯看出他的喜悅。

examples.en: The need for more teachers is evident to everyone.
examples.zh: 每個人都看得出需要更多老師。

examples.en: Don't exaggerate; the movie wasn't that bad.
examples.zh: 別誇張了，那部電影沒那麼糟。

examples.en: He likes to exaggerate when he tells stories about his trips.
examples.zh: 他講旅行的故事時總愛誇大其詞。

examples.en: The ad exaggerates the benefits of the product.
examples.zh: 這則廣告誇大了產品的好處。

examples.en: Everyone passed the test without exception.
examples.zh: 所有人無一例外都通過了考試。

examples.en: Most students wear uniforms, but Tom is an exception.
examples.zh: 大部分學生都穿制服，但湯姆是個例外。

examples.en: The store is open every day with the exception of Monday.
examples.zh: 這家店除了星期一以外天天營業。

examples.en: The long hike exhausted all of us.
examples.zh: 這趟長途健行讓我們全都筋疲力盡。

examples.en: We may exhaust our supply of water if we stay longer.
examples.zh: 如果待久一點，我們的水可能會用完。

examples.en: Taking care of three children can exhaust anyone.
examples.zh: 照顧三個孩子會讓任何人累壞。

examples.en: The exhaust from the bus made the air smell bad.
examples.zh: 公車排出的廢氣讓空氣聞起來很糟。

examples.en: A broken exhaust pipe can be dangerous.
examples.zh: 破損的排氣管可能很危險。

examples.en: The mechanic checked the exhaust of the old car.
examples.zh: 技師檢查了那輛舊車的排氣系統。

examples.en: The museum will exhibit paintings from local artists.
examples.zh: 博物館將展出當地藝術家的畫作。

examples.en: Students exhibited their science projects in the hall.
examples.zh: 學生們在大廳展示他們的科學專案。

examples.en: Some dogs exhibit signs of fear during storms.
examples.zh: 有些狗在暴風雨期間會表現出害怕的跡象。

examples.en: The exhibit on dinosaurs is popular with children.
examples.zh: 恐龍展很受小朋友歡迎。

examples.en: We spent an hour at the photo exhibit.
examples.zh: 我們在攝影展待了一個小時。

examples.en: Each exhibit has a short description beside it.
examples.zh: 每件展品旁邊都有簡短的說明。

examples.en: The company plans to expand its business to Asia.
examples.zh: 這家公司打算把業務拓展到亞洲。

examples.en: Water expands when it freezes.
examples.zh: 水結冰時會膨脹。

examples.en: Reading helps expand your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 閱讀有助於擴充你的字彙量。

examples.en: The expansion of the airport will take two years.
examples.zh: 機場的擴建工程需要兩年。

examples.en: The company announced an expansion into the Japanese market.
examples.zh: 這家公司宣布將擴展到日本市場。

examples.en: Heat causes the expansion of metal.
examples.zh: 熱會使金屬膨脹。

examples.en: The school is trying an experimental method of teaching math.
examples.zh: 學校正在嘗試一種實驗性的數學教學法。

examples.en: The experimental bus runs on electricity.
examples.zh: 這輛實驗用的公車以電力行駛。

examples.en: It is still an experimental program, so changes may happen.
examples.zh: 這仍是實驗性質的計畫，所以可能會有變動。

examples.en: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the new rule.
examples.zh: 老師對新規定做了清楚的說明。

examples.en: She has no explanation for why she was late.
examples.zh: 她對自己為什麼遲到沒有任何解釋。

examples.en: Please read the explanation before you start the test.
examples.zh: 開始測驗之前請先閱讀說明。

examples.en: The explosion was heard from far away.
examples.zh: 很遠的地方都聽得到那聲爆炸。

examples.en: There has been an explosion in the number of online shops.
examples.zh: 網路商店的數量暴增。

examples.en: Workers left the building after the gas explosion.
examples.zh: 瓦斯爆炸後，工人都離開了大樓。

senses.zh: 爆炸性的；易爆的；暴躁的

examples.en: Gas is explosive, so keep it away from fire.
examples.zh: 瓦斯易爆炸，所以要遠離火源。

examples.en: The movie became an explosive hit across Asia.
examples.zh: 這部電影在亞洲爆紅。

examples.en: He has an explosive temper when he is tired.
examples.zh: 他累的時候脾氣很暴躁。

examples.en: Workers used explosives to open a tunnel through the mountain.
examples.zh: 工人用炸藥開通穿過山的隧道。

examples.en: Explosives must be stored in a safe place.
examples.zh: 炸藥必須存放在安全的地方。

examples.en: The engineer was trained to handle explosives.
examples.zh: 那位工程師受過處理炸藥的訓練。

examples.en: Don't expose the photos to direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 別讓照片曝曬在陽光直射下。

examples.en: The reporter exposed a serious problem in the company.
examples.zh: 記者揭露了這家公司的一項嚴重問題。

examples.en: Parents should expose their children to different cultures.
examples.zh: 父母應該讓孩子接觸不同的文化。

examples.en: Long exposure to the sun can hurt your skin.
examples.zh: 長時間曬太陽可能傷害皮膚。

examples.en: The actor got a lot of exposure from the TV show.
examples.zh: 那位演員因為這個電視節目獲得很高的曝光度。

examples.en: Early exposure to English helps children learn faster.
examples.zh: 及早接觸英文有助於孩子學得更快。

examples.en: The library decided to extend its opening hours.
examples.zh: 圖書館決定延長開放時間。

examples.en: The road extends all the way to the beach.
examples.zh: 這條路一直延伸到海灘。

examples.en: Can you extend the deadline until Friday?
examples.zh: 你可以把截止日期延到星期五嗎？

examples.en: I agree with you to some extent.
examples.zh: 我在某種程度上同意你。

examples.en: The storm's extent was larger than we expected.
examples.zh: 這場風暴的規模比我們預期的大。

examples.en: No one knew the full extent of the damage.
examples.zh: 沒有人知道損害的全貌。

examples.en: His facial expression showed that he was surprised.
examples.zh: 他的臉部表情顯示他很驚訝。

examples.en: She bought a facial cream at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 她在藥妝店買了一罐臉部保養霜。

examples.en: The doctor checked the facial skin for allergies.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查臉部皮膚有沒有過敏。

examples.en: She booked a facial for Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她預約了星期六下午的臉部護理。

examples.en: A facial can help your skin feel fresh.
examples.zh: 臉部護理可以讓皮膚感覺清爽。

examples.en: My sister gave my mom a facial as a gift.
examples.zh: 我姊姊送我媽媽臉部護理當禮物。

examples.en: The school has a new sports facility.
examples.zh: 學校有一座新的運動設施。

examples.en: The hotel offers facilities for people with disabilities.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供身心障礙者使用的設施。

examples.en: This research facility is open to the public once a year.
examples.zh: 這個研究機構一年開放給大眾參觀一次。

examples.en: The dog was faithful to its owner for many years.
examples.zh: 那隻狗多年來對主人忠心耿耿。

examples.en: She is a faithful friend who always keeps her promises.
examples.zh: 她是個忠實的朋友，總是信守承諾。

examples.en: The movie is faithful to the original novel.
examples.zh: 這部電影忠於原著小說。

examples.en: The singer rose to fame at the age of twenty.
examples.zh: 那位歌手二十歲就成名了。

examples.en: Fame did not change the way she treated her fans.
examples.zh: 成名並沒有改變她對待粉絲的方式。

examples.en: The small town is known for its fame in tea making.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮以製茶聞名。

examples.en: She loves reading fantasy novels about dragons and magic.
examples.zh: 她喜歡閱讀有關龍與魔法的奇幻小說。

examples.en: His dream of becoming a king was just a fantasy.
examples.zh: 他想當國王的夢想只是空想。

examples.en: Children often live in a world of fantasy.
examples.zh: 孩子常常活在幻想的世界裡。

examples.en: We held a farewell party for our teacher.
examples.zh: 我們為老師辦了一場歡送會。

examples.en: She waved farewell to her friends at the airport.
examples.zh: 她在機場向朋友揮手道別。

examples.en: The speech was a warm farewell to the team.
examples.zh: 這場演說是對團隊溫馨的告別。

examples.en: Please fasten your seat belt before the bus moves.
examples.zh: 公車開動前請繫好安全帶。

examples.en: He fastened the box with strong tape.
examples.zh: 他用堅固的膠帶把箱子封好。

examples.en: She fastened the sign to the wall.
examples.zh: 她把告示牌固定在牆上。

senses.zh: 致命的；造成嚴重後果的

examples.en: The doctor said the disease was not fatal.
examples.zh: 醫生說這個病不會致命。

examples.en: Using a phone while driving can lead to fatal accidents.
examples.zh: 開車時使用手機可能導致致命的意外。

examples.en: One small mistake had a fatal effect on the plan.
examples.zh: 一個小錯誤對這項計畫造成了毀滅性的影響。

examples.en: The weather was favorable for our picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣很適合我們野餐。

examples.en: The new teacher made a favorable impression on the class.
examples.zh: 新老師給全班留下了良好的印象。

examples.en: Most people gave a favorable answer to the survey.
examples.zh: 大部分的人在問卷中給了正面的回答。

examples.en: Please send me the contract by fax.
examples.zh: 請用傳真把合約寄給我。

examples.en: The office still has an old fax in the corner.
examples.zh: 辦公室角落還放著一台舊的傳真機。

examples.en: I received a fax from the bank this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上收到銀行傳來的傳真。

examples.en: Could you fax this form to the school?
examples.zh: 你可以把這份表格傳真給學校嗎？

examples.en: She faxed the report to her boss right away.
examples.zh: 她立刻把報告傳真給老闆。

examples.en: We faxed the order to the supplier.
examples.zh: 我們把訂單傳真給供應商。
